settings.dateFormat: not set: GnuCash's default, locale, which under C is %m/%d/%y; no check reads a date

book: liability-test (:302-318): top-level ASSET account-1, CREDIT account-2 and INCOME account-3; a $100 loan on 2016-10-01 (account-2 to account-1), then on the 1st of January to May 2017 $10 of income and on the 2nd a $9 repayment. No date depends on now. In GnuCash's run this test shares its book with multi-acct-test and asset-test.
optionValues: Options are those changed from the template's defaults. {"absolute": day} is gnc-dmy2time64 of that day, local (here UTC) midnight.
cellSelection: GnuCash reads text at HTML table positions with sxml->table-row-col (5.17:gnucash/report/test/test-report-extras.scm:96-109) after stripping <script> elements: table 1; row 0 is the <th> header row, row 1 the first data row, row -1 the last; null column means every cell. A check with "count" expects the number of cells selected rather than their text.

checks.name: 2 columns
checks.meaning: Two header cells: Date and the account

checks.name: first row $100.00
checks.meaning: Amount owed at the first date, 2017-01-01, before the first repayment; shown positive

checks.name: last row $55.00
checks.meaning: Amount owed in the last row, after the five $9 repayments
